title: Young Trees

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Every spring, new trees spring up from acorns and seeds the squirrels forgot to eat!

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Let's measure these young trees, so we can see how much they grow by next spring.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Stack blocks beside each young tree until the stack is just as tall.
steps.question: tallest

older.question: difference
older.prompt: Measure each young tree with the blocks. Then we'll compare them.

feedback.all_good: Now we know how tall each one is. Let's come back next spring and see!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: One day these little trees will be as tall as the great oaks, and children not yet born will sit in their shade.

journal_line: I measured the young trees in the wilderness with Miss Miriam.
